purpose: Proposed executable contract for the R7 C4-to-C6 policy response. This is a model realization, not evidence of a historical baseline implementation.

evidence_refs: RequirementsAppendixB-refined(1).docx, Section B Table A R7
statements: C4 returns permit or deny with applicable obligations.
C6 enforces mask/filter obligations before disclosure.
C15 participates through labels or filters.
source_supported_responsibilities.boundary: These statements describe conceptual responsibilities; exact payloads and failure rules below are proposed.

item_variants.meaning: Remove every named top-level field from every disclosed model record.
Return only records whose named date lies within the inclusive bounds.

proposed_processing_rules: Validate the entire decision and every obligation before releasing any data.
Permit applies every supplied obligation; obligations are combined, not selected as alternatives.
An empty obligations array on a permit decision means no additional disclosure transformation. This does not bypass independently required authorization or consent checks.
Unknown actions, missing required fields, invalid types or dates, reversed date bounds, additional payload fields, or inability to enforce any obligation block disclosure.
Filter records first, then remove fields, so masking the date field cannot bypass date filtering.
A missing or invalid record date when date filtering is required blocks disclosure for this modeled request.
A mask target absent from a record requires no change to that record because the field is already absent.
On blocked disclosure, release no partial result and record the enforcement outcome through the separately assessed audit interaction.

modeling_assumptions.detail: Field names, action identifiers and JSON representation are proposed; they are not extracted API definitions.
Test records are flat synthetic objects, not complete FHIR resources. Masking means field removal, not replacement or cryptographic masking.
Dates are calendar dates with inclusive bounds. Timezones, timestamps and nested FHIR paths are outside this pilot.
Unsupported, malformed or unenforceable obligations block disclosure. Appendix B does not specify this failure rule.
The harness will associate a policy response with the correct request. Correlation, authentication, transport and replay protection are not assessed by this contract.

planned_test_cases.name: Mask and date filter apply together

follow_up_tests: Missing obligations field versus explicitly empty array
Missing or invalid dates in source records
assessment_boundaries: The planned tests have not been executed.
Testing one shared schema does not establish independently implemented C4 and C6 compatibility. Compare actual producer and consumer contracts when available.
Passing these cases supports only this proposed realization and tested inputs.
Complete R7 satisfaction additionally requires policy and consent correctness, all relevant flow interactions, and suitable negative cases.
This contract must not change historical baseline coverage to full or be treated as an independently reproduced ATAM gap.
